faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by NABARD Financial Services, commonly known as NABFINS, for filling banking sector field roles in Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NABFINS?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Customer Service Officer - Field Work under advertisement number Nabfins/OPS/1151 for deployment across various regional locations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed their PUC or 10+2 education from a recognized board to be eligible for this customer service field role.

faq.question: Q4. Is prior experience mandatory to apply for this position?
faq.answer: No, freshers are eligible to apply. However, candidates with 1-3 years of relevant field operations experience are preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 12-10-2026. Applicants must ensure submissions reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this job opening?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to send their detailed resume and required documents via email to the official address provided by NABFINS.

faq.question: Q7. What is the designated email address for sending applications?
faq.answer: Applications and resumes must be emailed directly to [email protected] with the appropriate subject line mentioning the post applied for.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any specific language requirements for the candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must have a good written, spoken, and reading command over both English and the local language of the operational region.

faq.question: Q9. Is an application fee required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification, making it free for all eligible candidates to apply via email.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be posted in various operational locations across Karnataka, including Hunasagi, Jewargi, Raichur, Devadurga, Yadgir, and others.
